resources.string: 🐱 Mia the Cat
An agile cat girl: ears, tail and soft paws. Small and light - jumps the highest.
🤖 Bolt the Robot
A wide iron robot with antennas, shoulder pads and a glowing visor. His magnet lasts longer and reaches further.
😈 Spark the Imp
A mischievous red imp with horns and a tail. Greedy for gold: more coins per run.
😇 Lyra the Angel
Tall and slim, with white wings and a golden halo. Luck is on her side - power-ups last longer.
🛡 Thunder the Knight
A mighty knight with steel shoulder pads and a scarlet cape. Always starts with a shield.
👑 King Coinus
A grand king with a crown and a mantle. His score is doubled for the first seconds.
🦊 Ginger the Fox
A sly red fox with a bushy tail. His first stumble is forgiven - the guard won\'t catch him.
🔥 Sun Phoenix
LEGENDARY. A fire bird in human form: blazing wings, halo and a fiery aura. Rises once per run after a crash.
🐉 Ice Dragon
LEGENDARY. A horned dragon with icy wings and tail, frost aura. +50% coins and a long magnet.
🌑 Dark Lord
LEGENDARY. Crown, horns, armor and a dark cape, purple aura. Shield and double score from the first second.
⚔ Cyber Samurai
LEGENDARY. Neon armor, cape, visor and antennas, crimson aura. Power-ups last 60% longer, first stumble forgiven.
